payload.title: Reconcile the plan: commit convention with commitlint
payload.body: commands/next-task.md prescribes plan: <task-id> and plan: validate <task-id> commits for the plan-and-validate workflow, but this repo's commit-msg hook (commitlint) only allows feat/fix/docs/style/refactor/perf/test/build/ci/chore/revert, so plan: is rejected and every agent planning a non-trivial task here must improvise (this session used docs:). Fix one of: add plan to the commitlint type allowlist, OR update the canonical commands/next-task.md to use docs(plan): <task-id> (plan files live in docs/plans/), then regenerate the agent variants. Recommend the docs(plan): route. Files: commands/next-task.md, the commitlint config.
